name: Arishima Shouko
source:
Arishima Kaoru's wife. Editor.

Their married life has frozen over, not leaving space for even the slightest of touch between them.

She used to hope her husband to get up and start working towards his dream of becoming a novelist, but now she barely directs a word at him.

[From [url=https://laplacian.jp/yonagi/en]Laplacian[/url]]
